actual_working: At positive vertexwise widths Wick gives zero at odd total order and the finite labelled sum over D in Pi_k at even total order 2k; all self/unequal/empty-chain diagrams appear with coefficient one, an empty chain contributing the factor one. Green width is removed first (d3 Green-before-noise), matching the 005/006 construction.

For fixed m,n the two-term bound ||Y_m Y_n - X_m X_n||_1 <= ||Y_m-X_m||_2 ||Y_n||_2 + ||X_m||_2 ||Y_n-X_n||_2 -> 0 follows from the 006 joint L2 limits, so finite positive-width Wick sums pass to the individual two-chain limits in L1; the zero-order factor stays equal to one.

Same-horizon terminal-to-initial reversal: s'_j=t-s_{m+1-j}, y'_j=x-y_{m+1-j} (with the length-n counterpart on the second chain) and the involution rho(j)=m+1-j, rho(m+j)=m+n+1-j is a pairing bijection D -> {{rho(a),rho(b)}}. Covariance differences change sign and are absorbed by evenness of |.|^{-a0} and of gamma; each transformed chain has its own root (0,0). This is a change of variables in moment integrals, not pathwise noise reversal.

Summability U_N=sum_{n<=N} X_n -> u in L2 is supplied by 007/008; 009 independently gives the mild identification (it is not a premise of the present identity). Then |E U_N^2 - E u^2| <= ||U_N-u||_2 (||U_N||_2 + ||u||_2) -> 0.

Every J_{m,n,D} is nonnegative (positive Green measures times nonnegative covariance), so the finite expansions of E U_N^2 increase with N; the limit is the full double sum, independent of enumeration, and regrouping by total order gives E u^2 = sum_k sum_{m=0}^{2k} sum_D J_{m,2k-m,D}. Monotonicity is of nonnegative expected pairing terms, not samplewise monotonicity.
The constructor factors 005/006, the summability 007/008 and the mild identification 009 do not assume this mixed expansion; no hidden circular use of the final second-moment bound is present.

actual_working: Occupied multiplication: for centered linear Gaussian H and F in the closed total-degree<=n Gaussian polynomial space, ||HF||_2 <= 2 sqrt(n+1) ||H||_2 ||F||_2 via Hermite creation/annihilation (creation norm <= sqrt(n+1), annihilation norm <= sqrt(n), triangle sum); finite-coordinate approximation closes the degree-closed space; F may depend on H, and H=0 is trivial. V_a=gamma_delta^0(0) gamma_{2epsilon}(0) is finite at positive widths.

Strong measurability and continuity: positive-width terminal terms are jointly strongly measurable by rescaled unit-time Bochner construction; coupled spatial stationarity gives ||Y_n^b(s,y)-X_n(s,y)||_2 = ||Y_n^b(s,0)-X_n(s,0)||_2, so the 006 fixed-order limit is spatially uniform at fixed s and X_n(s,.) and u(s,.) have continuous E-representatives.

Fixed-external-width Bochner domination: ||W_a(s,y)X_{n-1}(s,y)||_2 <= 2 sqrt(n) sqrt(V_a) q_{n-1}(T) uniformly in 0<=s<=T and y in R^d (008 q-bounds plus spatial invariance); the spatial Green mass is t-s, so time-space Bochner integration is dominated.

Fixed-random-factor Gaussian averaging of the Green measure: for F_s(z)=W_a(s,x-z)R(s,x-z), R=X_{n-1} or u, which is E-continuous in z and globally bounded in E by M, Bochner Fubini against p_eta*G_tau is valid because the double norm is <= tau M. Over a compact ball K the compact E-modulus omega_{s,x,K}(r)->0 and the Gaussian tail P(|Z_eta|>r) <= min(1,d eta/r^2) give ||int(p_eta*G_tau)F_s - int G_tau F_s||_E <= tau [omega(r)+2M P(|Z_eta|>r)] -> 0 by first eta then r. Time dominated convergence with the integrable bound 2(t-s)M gives the time integral limit. No time-uniform modulus and no uniformity in a are claimed; the random factor is FIXED as eta varies.

Partial/external/order limits: I_{n,a}=int G(t-s,x-dz) W_a(s,x-z) X_{n-1}(s,x-z) ds equals lim_b Y_n^{(b,a)} in E by the multiplication bound times ||Y_{n-1}^b-X_{n-1}||_2; the width-uniform sup_{a>0} ||I_{n,a}||_2 <= q_n(t) follows from 008 through the partial limit. For the external limit use 006 joint convergence: choose rho with all vertex widths below rho giving ||Y_n^{(b,a)}-X_n||_2 < zeta, fix a below rho, then let b->0 to get ||I_{n,a}-X_n||_2 <= zeta; hence I_{n,a}->X_n as a->0 with no separate partial-limit theorem or rate.

Full product and order-last closure: sum_{n>=1} ||W_a X_{n-1}||_2 <= 2 sqrt(V_a) sum_{n>=1} sqrt(n) q_{n-1}(T) < infinity; closedness of multiplication and an a.s. subsequence identify the product series with W_a u, so I_a=int G W_a u = sum_n I_{n,a} in E. Finally ||I_a-(u-1)||_2 <= sum_{n=1}^N ||I_{n,a}-X_n||_2 + 2 sum_{n>N} q_n(t); first a->0 at fixed N, then N->infinity by 008 summability. This is the onefold Stratonovich mild equation in L2(Omega).
